videos.title: Titans
videos.overview: Rachel Roth, a teen haunted by dark visions and powers, falls under the wing of Detective Dick Grayson. We also meet Kory Anders and Beast Boy Gar Logan.

videos.title: Hawk and Dove
videos.overview: In search of a safe haven for Rachel, Dick arrives on the doorstep of vigilante heroes Hawk and Dove.

videos.title: Origins
videos.overview: Rachel and Kory travel to the convent where Rachel was raised, while Dick compares his own orphan experience to Rachel’s. Meanwhile, Rachel befriends Gar Logan.

videos.title: Doom Patrol
videos.overview: Gar brings Rachel home to his “family” – a group of misfit medical experiments we’ll come to know as The Doom Patrol (including Robotman, Negative Man and Elastigirl).

videos.title: Together
videos.overview: When the Nuclear Family tracks them down, Dick, Kory, Rachel and Gar decide to stop running and work together – and the team that will be known as “The Titans” is formed.

videos.title: Jason Todd
videos.overview: Before he can reunite with The Titans, Dick reluctantly teams with Jason Todd, the new Robin, to catch a serial killer targeting people from Dick’s past.

videos.title: Asylum
videos.overview: The Titans set out to rescue Rachel’s birth mother from a mysterious psychiatric facility, but find themselves confronting their deepest vulnerabilities and fears.

videos.title: Donna Troy
videos.overview: As The Titans go their separate ways, Dick turns to an old friend, Donna Troy, for answers.

videos.title: Hank and Dawn
videos.overview: The origin story of Hank Hall and Dawn Granger’s relationship and the loss in each of their pasts that brings them together as vigilante Super Heroes Hawk and Dove.

videos.title: Koriand'r
videos.overview: As Kory’s memories come flooding back, she discovers her true mission, regarding Rachel. While Dick and Donna discover Kory’s alien origins, Rachel uses her powers to save Gar.

videos.title: Dick Grayson
videos.overview: Dick takes a dark journey back to Gotham in the finale.

videos.title: Trigon
videos.overview: The season premiere continues the apocalyptic events of last season as Trigon sets out to win the Titans over to his side by embracing their inner darkness.

videos.title: Rose
videos.overview: While Dick trains the next generation of Titans, Donna and Kory track down a rogue metahuman. But an old threat drives the Titans – old and new – back together.

videos.title: Ghosts
videos.overview: The old Titans reluctantly return to Titans Tower to strategize against an old enemy. But the secrets of the Titans’ past threaten to tear apart this newly formed team from within.

videos.title: Aqualad
videos.overview: Four years ago, Dick, Donna, Hank & Dawn formed the Titans with Garth aka Aqualad. But the team is tested with the arrival of a new villain.

videos.title: Deathstroke
videos.overview: With the team in upheaval, the Titans do everything in their power to save Jason’s life. But when Deathstroke demands they turn over Rose, the dilemma threatens to tear the team apart.

videos.title: Conner
videos.overview: Conner Kent and Krypto escape from Cadmus Labs. His search for the truth about his past leads him to Lionel Luthor and genetic scientist Dr. Eve Watson.

videos.title: Bruce Wayne
videos.overview: With tensions running high at Titans Tower, Kory tries to learn more about Conner, while Dick sets out alone to track down Deathstroke – with a familiar voice haunting him.

videos.title: Jericho
videos.overview: Dick befriends Jericho Wilson to learn more about Deathstroke.

videos.title: Atonement
videos.overview: In the aftermath of his confession, Dick’s fear that his secret would break up the Titans comes true. Abandoning Titans Tower, the heroes all go their separate ways.

videos.title: Fallen
videos.overview: Titans Tower comes under attack by Mercy Graves.

videos.title: E.L._.O.
videos.overview: With Dick still in prison and Gar under the microscope at Cadmus, the remaining Titans are called together to save their teammates.

videos.title: Faux Hawk
videos.overview: Hank finds himself at a new low, cage-fighting for money, when he finds an imposter now acting as Hawk.

videos.title: Nightwing
videos.overview: The Titans battle Deathstroke & more in the season finale.

videos.title: Barbara Gordon
videos.overview: Desperate to leave his mark, Jason Todd confronts the Joker once and for all. But when fatal consequences ensue, Dick Grayson is forced to step away from the Titans and return to Gotham City.

videos.title: Red Hood
videos.overview: With the Joker out of the picture, the mysterious Red Hood takes charge. But after bringing the Titans back to Gotham City, Dick is confronted by the city’s newest villain - and his shocking real identity.

videos.title: Hank & Dove
videos.overview: After unearthing an empty grave, the Titans confirm that an old friend is alive - and behind the city’s latest emerging threat. Then, when a Titan falls for Red Hood’s trap, the team races against the clock to save one of their own.

videos.title: Blackfire
videos.overview: Devastated by loss, the Titans find themselves in disarray. While Dick throws himself into drawing out Red Hood with Jonathan Crane, Kory and Gar work to understand Starfire's escalating visions, leading them to a surprising source.

videos.title: Lazarus
videos.overview: In the aftermath of his fight with Nightwing, anti-heroes Red Hood and Jonathan Crane reteam for the first phase of their fearsome plan. Then, through a series of flashbacks, Red Hood’s origins are revealed.

videos.title: Lady Vic
videos.overview: Dick and Barbara work to unmask the latest killer unleashed by Crane. When Kory and Gar bring her to the Tower, Blackfire forms an unexpected connection with a Titan.

Gotham’s crime families meet to discuss the fear toxin’s hold on the city – only to be confronted by the mastermind himself. As Dick and Barbara consult the Oracle to preempt Crane’s next move, Starfire and Blackfire reach an understanding.

videos.title: Home
videos.overview: As an emboldened Crane looks to filter his poison through Gotham’s water system, Starfire - still plagued by visions - enlists Blackfire and Superboy’s help, and Gar finally tracks down Jason.

videos.title: Souls
videos.overview: After waking up on a mysterious train, Tim Drake teams with two familiar heroes to locate an elusive bridge back to the land of the living. Meanwhile, Rachel grapples with her own powers in a desperate attempt to resurrect Donna.

videos.title: Troubled Water
videos.overview: Things go from bad to worse as the Titans are falsely blamed for poisoning the city, forcing them into a perilous position as they work to regain Gotham’s trust.

videos.title: The Call Is Coming from Inside the House
videos.overview: While Crane sets his ultimate sights on Nightwing, Gar and Rachel investigate Red Hood’s place of rebirth, Donna and Tim reconnect in the real world, and Kory learns the truth about her past.

videos.title: Prodigal
videos.overview: After Nightwing and Red Hood’s battle, Rachel and Gar try to save their friend. Meanwhile, Jason questions his allegiance. With Barbara behind bars, Donna leads her own resistance operation, and Conner helps Blackfire recover her ship.

videos.title: Purple Rain
videos.overview: With Gotham once again at the mercy of Crane’s terror, it’s all hands on deck for the Titans as they infiltrate Wayne Manor and harness an ancient power that transcends life and death.

videos.title: Lex Luthor
videos.overview: After Superman requests a meeting with Conner, the Titans travel to Metropolis for exclusive access to S.T.A.R. Labs. But when unexpected complications arise, including the re-emergence of Lex Luthor, Conner faces a tough decision.

videos.title: Mother Mayhem
videos.overview: In the wake of Lex Luthor's sudden demise, Conner finds himself framed for murder while the Titans try to piece together Luthor's suspicious connection to Rachel's haunting and clear their teammate's name.

videos.title: Jinx
videos.overview: With Rachel left powerless, Dick turns to an old friend whose magic could be the key to identifying their mysterious enemy. Meanwhile, Conner and Tim investigate attack victims, and Sebastian finds himself at the center of an eerie plot.

videos.title: Super Super Mart
videos.overview: As she grows closer to Sebastian, Rachel makes an unsettling discovery that leads the Titans to The Organization’s Asylum – where they come face-to-face with their deadliest foes yet.

videos.title: Inside Man
videos.overview: As the Blood Moon rises, the Titans fight to keep Sebastian from Mother Mayhem’s clutches, and an injured Conner gives rise to a venomous threat that jeopardizes the team’s plan.

videos.title: Brother Blood
videos.overview: The Titans race against time to save Sebastian before the Blood Moon ritual, while Conner’s new hardened personality rears, and Gar is presented with an ominous choice.

videos.title: Caul's Folly (1)
videos.overview: In the wake of Sebastian's transformation, the Titans race to retrieve Traigon's horn, leading them to the quaint – but eerie – town of Caul's Folly.

videos.title: Dick & Carol & Ted & Kory (2)
videos.overview: With Dick and Kory at risk of falling victim to the spell of Caul's Folly, Bernard and Tim attempt to crack the town's mystery before it's too late.

videos.title: Dude, Where's My Gar
videos.overview: After being separated from the Titans, Gar uncovers long-lost secrets from his past as he confronts his mysterious connection to the Red.

videos.title: Game Over
videos.overview: With help from Conner at Lexcorp, Sebastian manifests his powers in a sinister new way, as Dick and Rachel have a close encounter with black magic.

videos.title: Project Starfire
videos.overview: An unexpected reunion sheds light on Project Starfire, forcing Kory to make a difficult decision that puts her powers to the ultimate test.

videos.title: Titans Forever
videos.overview: With Brother Blood at full power and Conner left in critical condition, the Titans join forces to find and defeat Sebastian once and for all.
